gap_text: Dagu pin v2.16.6 is behind upstream v2.17.0 (pin_behind_upstream true). The newer release is untested; that means unknown, not failed.
next_check: Install dagu v2.17.0 in a new prefix with a disposable DAGU_HOME. Rerun the hosting receipt's failure, abort, cancel and restart-history checks, then compare the outcomes with the v2.16.6 receipt before changing the pin.

preregistration.expectation: The dagu 2.17.0 upgrade decision belongs to evidence/artifacts/sota-refresh-20260923/pins-runtime/dagu.json (merged #87), which reran job recovery and the in-flight kill check but not the hosting receipt's failure, cancel and restart-history checks. Running those three checks with the same harness on 2.16.6 and 2.17.0 in disposable DAGU_HOMEs should give identical outcomes: exit-23 step -> failed, dependent step aborted, CLI exit 1; dagu stop -> aborted with stop exit 0; history rows preserved across a server restart.
preregistration.criteria: The pin decision is covered_elsewhere (sota-refresh #87). The supplementary comparison passes iff both versions report the same native statuses for failure, cancel and the restarted server's history API, recorded side by side; any difference is recorded as a finding, not a failure of the upgrade.

results.hosting_receipt_2026_09_19: failure_fixture {requested_step_exit 23, cli_exit 1, status failed, dependent_step aborted}; cancellation_fixture {stop_exit 0, cancelled_cli_exit 0, status aborted}; prior_history_rows_preserved true
results.comparison: Both versions reproduce the 2026-09-19 hosting receipt shape: exit-23 step -> failed with the dependent step aborted and CLI exit 1; dagu stop -> aborted with stop exit 0 and the cancelled dagu start exiting 0; CLI history and the /api/v1/dags latest runs unchanged across a dagu server SIGTERM and restart.

limits: Disposable DAGU_HOMEs on loopback ports with auth.mode none; the restart is a dagu server process restart in that home, not a systemd user-service restart of dagu-equities (which was not touched).
Fixture DAGs are minimal shell steps, not the research-evidence.yaml workflow; the 2026-09-19 receipt's LEAN/validator workflow was not rerun.
Single run per version on one WSL2 host.
The pin itself was not changed here; the ledger rows are forbidden paths for this unit and the upgrade decision belongs to the sota-refresh record.
